description: Search the live Batoo marketplace, including Batoo and EasyMLS listings. Filter by builder, model, boat type, specific subcategory, country, price, year, dimensions, cabins, capacity, engine hours and speed. Open full public listing details, compare up to five boats and follow each result to its canonical page on batoo.it. The plugin is read-only and never creates leads or contacts brokers.
